Coefficients:.reasoning: This column lists the predictor variables (e.g., Month July, City Detroit) in the statistical model.

Estimate.reasoning: This column holds the calculated coefficient values (effect size) from the regression model.

Std. Error.reasoning: This column provides the standard error associated with the coefficient estimates.

t Value.reasoning: This column contains the calculated t-statistic for the respective coefficient.

Pr(>.reasoning: This column holds the p-value, indicating statistical significance of the coefficient.

t.reasoning: This column is intended for statistical values (e.g., confidence intervals) but is empty in the sample.

).reasoning: This column is intended for statistical values (e.g., confidence intervals) but is empty in the sample.
